title: haplocoelum wakefieldii
intro: Haplocoelum wakefieldii, commonly known as Wild Jasmine or Wakefield's Jasmine, is a medicinal plant species belonging to the Rutaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, inflammation, and respiratory problems, and has been reported to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Haplocoelum wakefieldii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, terpenes, and alkaloids, that have been shown to possess anti-histaminic, anti-spasmodic, and anti-bacterial activities. Research has also identified limonoids, coumarins, and phenolic acids in this plant, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential applications in traditional medicine.
